Which one of the following is NOT a principle of "Panchsheel"?
o: Mutual respect for each other's territorial integrity and sovereignty
Mutual non-interference in each other's internal affairs
x: The Panchsheel Agreement was signed in 1954 between India and China. It laid down five principles for peaceful relations between nations. The five principles of Panchsheel are:  Mutual respect for territorial integrity and sovereignty  Mutual non-aggression  Mutual non-interference in internal affairs  Equality and mutual benefit  Peaceful coexistence  Non-alignment is NOT part of Panchsheel. It is a separate foreign policy principle followed by India, especially under Jawaharlal Nehru, referring to not joining military blocs.

s: Which one of the following is not a principle of “Panchsheel”?
o: Mutual respect for each other’s territorial integrity
Mutual non-interference in each other’s internal affairs
x: The Meaning of ‘’Panchsheel’’ is the five rules of behaviour or conduct as given below. (i) Mutual respect for the geo-regional integrity and sovereignty of each other, (ii) Mutual non-aggression. (iii) Non-interference in the internal matters of each other. (iv) Mutual benefits and equality. (v) Peaceful co-existence. Non-alignment is not a principle of Panchsheel but the policy of non-alignment itself is based on the principles of Panchsheel.

s: Among the following principle which one is not a part of Panchsheel?
o: Mutual non-interference in each other's internal affairs
Mutual respect for each other's territorial integrity and sovereignty
x: Panchsheel comprises territorial integrity and sovereignty, non-aggression, non-interference, equality and mutual benefit, and peaceful co-existence. Non-alignment (NAM) is a separate policy and not a Panchsheel principle.

s:
Consider the following statements.

I. Panchsheel agreement was signed between India and Republic of China after the 1962 war.

II. To support each other of Global forum is one of the principle of Panchsheel agreement?
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: Panchsheel was signed on 29 April 1954, well before the 1962 war, so statement I is wrong. Supporting each other in global forums is not one of the five principles, so II is wrong as well.

s:

I. Peaceful co-existence.

II. Mutual protection of the environment.

III. Mutual protection of indigenous population.

IV. Mutual non-aggression.

x: The five principles include peaceful co-existence and non-aggression. Mutual protection of the environment and of the indigenous population are not among them, so I and IV is correct.

s: We, along with China, are celebrating 50 years of Panchsheel. Apart from us, which country was associated in proposing Panchsheel?
x: Burma (now Myanmar) adopted Panchsheel in 1954 right after the India-China agreement, so it is the country associated with it. Vietnam, Nepal and Thailand are not.

x: The UNGA recognised Panchsheel in 1957, after its absorption into the Bandung Ten Principles (1955) and before Belgrade (1961).

x: Peaceful co-existence is one of the five Panchsheel principles. Non-alignment is a separate policy of India, not a Panchsheel principle.
